prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait of FOUR women arranged in a diamond. Woman #1 is at the top, standing in the back, centred; woman #2 on the left and woman #3 on the right are at the middle height, with a clear gap of background between them; woman #4 is at the bottom, standing in front, centred, lower than the others, her shoulders overlapping slightly in front of the shoulders of #2 and #3. The four heads form a diamond: the chin of #1 clears the crowns of #2 and #3, and the crown of #4 sits below the chins of #1, #2 and #3, so that every face, jaw and neck is fully visible and no face is covered by another. All four face the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of #1's head down to the line of #4's shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them. Women #1 and #3 share the same surgically sculpted lips, eyes and nose, pushed to the absolute extreme: their lips are the absolute extreme of 'Russian lips', a cartoon-doll mouth made real: the upper lip pressing right up against the base of her nose and the lower lip reaching the very tip of her chin, so the whole mouth is one enormous, glossy, perfectly symmetrical dome and by far the biggest thing on her face; their eyes are pure fantasy eyes about ten times their natural length and far taller and rounder than normal: the inner corners fully opened with the small pink inner corners visible, the outer corners sweeping across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline, two colossal almond-shaped eyes each with a huge round iris and a clean sweep of white on both sides, symmetrical and graceful, a fine eyeliner in the colour of her makeup ending in a long point swept up above each ear, in very large doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine, a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; their nose is the most extreme surgical nose imaginable: an extremely tall, knife-edged bridge, a long needle-pointed tip projecting far forward and tilted slightly upward, and nostril wings pinched to thin slit-like nostrils; and the outline of each of their faces (forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin) is her own, a different silhouette for each of them, described in her own paragraph below. Each of them keeps her own makeup, lip colour, lens colour, hair and piercings as described below, and the two faces are two different women who simply share these extreme lips, eyes and nose, and the other two women have the faces and lips described in their own paragraphs.

Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, never distorted, never grotesque.

The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel set with small clear diamonds, one-colour, restrained, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed.

Her eyes are huge, wide, saucer-shaped almond eyes, extra-large with a big visible iris in vivid hazel-gold big-iris contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, framed by very bold, thick, long lashes and heavy pink-and-gold shimmer eyeshadow with a sharp winged liner, and thin, high, sharply arched brows. Her lips are extremely plump, big, glossy hot-pink lips with a darker pink lip liner outline and a pronounced cupid's bow, slightly pouting. A small, narrow, upturned nose, high sculpted cheekbones, and a small pointed chin. A sassy, confident, playful look straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

Her ear weights are each a different shape and a different metal among gold, bronze, iron, tin, brass, silver, copper and lead.

Ear weights, for the women who wear weights in their lobes: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all four weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

Earrings: the large earrings of the women who wear them hang freely in the air down to the level of the collarbone and no lower, and no earring of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: all four women stand upright, arms relaxed, heads level and facing the camera; #2 and #3 lean very slightly toward the centre, #4 leans very slightly forward, and #1 stands tall in the gap behind them. The hanging ear pieces of #1, #2 and #3 end no lower than the level of their own chins so that they hang in clear view, those of #4 hang in front of her own neck and shoulder down to the level of her collarbones, and no hanging piece of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep teal backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
